A. Generation and Counts

Synthetic experiment policy

Rules enforced for the added synthetic-data experiment. These rules do not modify the original-only pipeline or the fixed final holdout evaluation.

Policy Value
0 Synthetic generation scope Generated separately inside each plant-grouped development training fold
1 Validation rows Genuine real development leaves only
2 Holdout usage Fixed 20% holdout is not used for generation, selection, tuning, or validation in this experiment
3 Source spectra Raw leaf-level spectra after repeated-scan and area-to-leaf averaging, before smoothing/normalization/features
4 Allocation Deterministic Label x Week allocation; label totals differ by at most one and week totals follow fold-training week proportions within label
5 Pairing rule Same Label and Week, preferably same DAT, different Sample_Group_ID values
6 Residual fallback Label+Week+DAT, then Label+Week, then Week, then any residual from current fold-training plants
7 Alpha Uniform(0.3, 0.7)
8 Noise 0.2 x real repeated-scan residual from fold-training rows
9 Rejection loop Maximum attempts = requested count x 20; requested counts cannot be silently reduced
10 Feature extraction Synthetic features are produced only by preprocess_leaf_spectra()
11 Model Locked LogisticRegression with clf__C=10 and threshold 0.5
